name: Old Salt Tavern
description: Old Salt Tavern is Orange Beach's neighborhood new hangout for made-from-scratch food, cold drinks, sports, and good times. Come hungry, stay awhile, and feel right at home. A Social Gathering Spot: Great Food, Great Service in an Upscale Environment. We are located in the Wal-Mart Shopping Center in Orange Beach. Formerly Stephi's, and Franco's Italian restaurant before that. We have made some big changes to the facility – come check it out!
address_line_1: 25241 Perdido Beach Blvd, Orange Beach, AL (next to Wal-Mart)
